question: What intense experience at the source of nectar affects even the wise practitioner?
premises: The practice involves the tip of nectar.
It is associated with the essence of juice.
Even a wise person experiences burning.
inference: Even the wise practitioner may feel a burning sensation at the source of nectar and essence.
uncertainties: The imagery of nectar and burning is metaphorically dense.
plain_english: Even the wise one may feel a burning at the tip of nectar, with the essence of its juice.
